name: apple_voicemail
title: Voicemail
description: Read voicemails synced from your iPhone to this Mac: list, transcripts and audio.
author: Iteractive Development

positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent voicemails newest first with sender, date, duration and read state

positive.prompt: Did anyone from 416 leave a voicemail?
positive.expected_behavior: Filters by the digits 416 ignoring phone formatting and lists the matches

positive.prompt: What does the voicemail from +1 437 703 0744 say?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the voicemail and quotes its transcript text

positive.prompt: Save the newest voicemail's audio to my Desktop
positive.expected_behavior: Copies the audio file to ~/Desktop and returns its path

positive.description: Unread voicemails in a date range
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only unread voicemails within the current week

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list iPhone voicemails synced to this Mac, read their transcripts, and get their audio recordings.

commands.name: get_voicemails
commands.title: Get Voicemails
commands.description: List voicemails synced from iPhone to this Mac, newest first, with sender, date, duration, read state, transcript availability and audio file path.

sender.description: Filter by sender phone number; partial match, formatting ignored for numbers

start.description: Only voicemails received at or after this ISO 8601 date/time

end.description: Only voicemails received before this ISO 8601 date/time

commands.name: get_transcript
commands.title: Get Voicemail Transcript
commands.description: Get the transcribed text of one voicemail by its id, as returned by get_voicemails.

commands.name: get_audio
commands.title: Get Voicemail Audio
commands.description: Get the audio recording of one voicemail by its id. Returns the file path, copying the file somewhere easy to use when the original is not directly readable.

destination.description: Optional absolute path to copy the audio file to

skills.name: apple-voicemail
skills.description: Read iPhone voicemails synced to this Mac through apple_voicemail APIs — list with filters, get transcripts, and get audio files.
